edits.hebrew: פסח מנלן - בין למצוה ובין לעכב? דקא סלקא דעתך, לא אתי לן כשאר זבחים משלמים, דלא כתיב בההוא קרא ד"זאת התורה" דאיתרבי כל הזבחים מיניה למצוה:

edits.english: From where do we know about the Pesach offering? Both for the mitzvah (initially) and for it to be indispensable (disqualifying if not done correctly)? For it might have entered your mind that it does not come to us from the peace offerings like other animal offerings, because it is not written in that verse of "This is the law" from which all other animal offerings were included as a mitzvah:

edits.hebrew: ואם מן הצאן קרבנו כו' - לאו קרא יתירא קא דריש; אלא משמעותא דקרא משמע ליה הכי: ואם דבר הבא מן הצאן, דהיינו פסח שאינו בא אלא מן הצאן, היה קרבנו הרי הוא לזבח שלמים. ועל כרחך שלא בזמנו קאמר, דאי בזמנו הא ילפינן ליה לעיל דפסול:

edits.english: And if his offering is of the flock, etc. - He does not derive it from a superfluous verse; rather, the plain meaning of the verse implies this to him: And if a thing that comes from the flock, meaning a Pesach offering which comes only from the flock, was his offering, behold it shall be a peace offering. And you are forced to say that he is speaking about when it is not in its [appointed] time, for if it were in its [appointed] time, we already derived above that it is unfit:
